architecture.causality: At history boundary j use x_j,u_j,a_j reconstructed from prior issued commands. Hidden starts zero and advances after enough prior feature rows exist. Update hidden once per forecast sample using start feature. Hold hidden and sampled feature history fixed across substeps. Never use future observations in prediction.
architecture.command_memory: One learned filter per command: da/dt=(u-a)/tau, tau=.001+softplus(raw_tau), initial tau=.05s, a=first supplied past command. Include both raw and filtered commands.
architecture.current_features: R.T@v, omega, R.T@g/abs(g), normalized issued u, normalized filtered a. Training-only normalization; append .1s sampled prior-feature differences and8 causal hidden coordinates.
architecture.head: Six accelerations: non-gravitational body specific acceleration3 plus body angular acceleration3. Affine all features, upper triangular quadratic products of current physical/input features only, width32 tanh residual with zero initial neural output.
architecture.initialization: Teacher-forced training secants: y_f=R_t.T@((v_next-v)/dt-g), y_alpha=(omega_next-omega)/dt. Actual filter/history, zero hidden for ridge. Training-only output scales. Affine ridge then quadratic ridge centered on affine;lambda=.01*N*H,bias unpenalized,seed0.
architecture.integrator: ceil(dt/.025) explicit-midpoint substeps. First head at current state/filter. R_half=R Exp(.5h omega), a_half=u+(a-u)exp(-.5h/tau); v_half and omega_half use first acceleration. Evaluate midpoint head; v_next=v+h(g+R_half*f_half), omega_next=omega+h*alpha_half, R_next=R Exp(h omega_half); filter exact fullstep exponential. Stable differentiable SO3 exponential at zero.
